title: build_panel.py
body:
"""T5 build_panel.py: pbp -> drive-play risk-set panel -> aggregated cells.

Usage: python build_panel.py SEASON [SEASON ...]   (writes cells_{season}.parquet)
       python build_panel.py --sample 2024          (1-season smoke test)

Each row of the panel = one play at risk. Event columns:
  e_score = 1 if drive ended in a score on this play
  e_dead  = 1 if drive ended scoreless on this play
  censored plays contribute to n only.
Aggregated over CELL_KEYS -> (n, e_score, e_dead). Saved per season.
"""
import os, sys, hashlib
import polars as pl
from common import (load_pbp_seasons, WORK, SCORE_SET, DEAD_SET, CENSOR_SET,
                    DROP_SET, KEEP_PLAY_TYPES, CELL_KEYS,
                    bin_ydstogo, bin_yardline, bin_scorediff, bin_clock)

OUTDIR = os.path.join(WORK, "cells")


def build_panel(pbp: pl.DataFrame) -> pl.DataFrame:
    df = pbp.filter(
        pl.col("drive").is_not_null()
        & pl.col("posteam").is_not_null()
        & pl.col("defteam").is_not_null()
        & pl.col("play_type").is_in(KEEP_PLAY_TYPES)
        & pl.col("fixed_drive_result").is_not_null()
    )
    cov_cols = ["down", "ydstogo", "yardline_100", "score_differential",
                "half_seconds_remaining"]
    n0 = df.shape[0]
    df = df.drop_nulls(cov_cols)
    print(f"dropped {n0 - df.shape[0]} plays with null covariates "
          f"({df.shape[0]} kept)", flush=True)
    # play index within drive
    df = df.sort(["game_id", "drive", "play_id"])
    df = df.with_columns(
        (pl.int_range(pl.len()).over(["game_id", "drive"]) + 1).alias("t_raw"))
    # drive outcome from last play
    last = df.group_by(["game_id", "drive"]).agg([
        pl.col("fixed_drive_result").last().alias("outcome"),
        pl.col("qb_kneel").last().alias("last_kneel"),
        pl.col("half_seconds_remaining").last().alias("last_clock"),
        pl.len().alias("drive_len"),
    ])
    df = df.join(last, on=["game_id", "drive"], how="left")
    df = df.filter(~pl.col("outcome").is_in(DROP_SET))
    # kneel-out-the-clock drives: censored per prereg
    df = df.with_columns(
        pl.when((pl.col("outcome").is_in(CENSOR_SET))
                | ((pl.col("last_kneel") == 1) & (pl.col("last_clock") <= 120))
                ).then(pl.lit("CENSORED"))
        .when(pl.col("outcome").is_in(SCORE_SET)).then(pl.lit("SCORE"))
        .when(pl.col("outcome").is_in(DEAD_SET)).then(pl.lit("DEAD"))
        .otherwise(pl.lit("OTHER")).alias("dtype")
    )
    other = df.filter(pl.col("dtype") == "OTHER")["outcome"].unique().to_list()
    if other:
        print(f"NOTE: dropping {len(other)} unclassified outcomes: {other}", flush=True)
    df = df.filter(pl.col("dtype") != "OTHER")
    is_last = pl.int_range(pl.len()).over(["game_id", "drive"]) + 1 == pl.col("drive_len")
    df = df.with_columns([
        (is_last & (pl.col("dtype") == "SCORE")).cast(pl.Int8).alias("e_score"),
        (is_last & (pl.col("dtype") == "DEAD")).cast(pl.Int8).alias("e_dead"),
        pl.when(pl.col("t_raw") >= 15).then(14).otherwise(pl.col("t_raw") - 1).alias("t_bin"),
        bin_ydstogo(pl.col("ydstogo")),
        bin_yardline(pl.col("yardline_100")),
        bin_scorediff(pl.col("score_differential")),
        bin_clock(pl.col("half_seconds_remaining")),
    ])
    df = df.with_columns([
        pl.col("posteam").cast(pl.Categorical),
        pl.col("defteam").cast(pl.Categorical),
        (pl.col("down") - 1).cast(pl.Int8).alias("down"),  # 0-based: 0 = 1st down
    ])
    cells = df.group_by(CELL_KEYS).agg([
        pl.len().alias("n"),
        pl.col("e_score").sum().alias("e_score"),
        pl.col("e_dead").sum().alias("e_dead"),
    ])
    drives = df.group_by(["game_id", "drive"]).agg([
        pl.col("posteam").first().alias("posteam"),
        pl.col("defteam").first().alias("defteam"),
        pl.col("season").first().alias("season"),
        pl.col("week").first().alias("week"),
        pl.col("home_team").first().alias("home_team"),
        pl.col("away_team").first().alias("away_team"),
        pl.col("epa").sum().alias("epa_sum"),
        pl.len().alias("n_plays"),
        pl.col("dtype").first().alias("dtype"),
    ])
    season = int(df["season"].first())
    wk = None
    if season >= 2011:
        wk = df.group_by(["week"] + CELL_KEYS).agg([
            pl.len().alias("n"),
            pl.col("e_score").sum().alias("e_score"),
            pl.col("e_dead").sum().alias("e_dead"),
        ])
    return cells, drives, wk


def main():
    args = [a for a in sys.argv[1:] if a != "--sample"]
    seasons = [int(a) for a in args]
    os.makedirs(OUTDIR, exist_ok=True)
    for s in seasons:
        print(f"=== season {s} ===", flush=True)
        pbp = load_pbp_seasons([s])
        print(f"pbp rows: {pbp.shape}", flush=True)
        cells, drives, wk = build_panel(pbp)
        print(f"cells: {cells.shape}, plays: {cells['n'].sum()}, "
              f"scores: {cells['e_score'].sum()}, deads: {cells['e_dead'].sum()}",
              flush=True)
        out = os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"cells_{s}.parquet")
        cells.write_parquet(out)
        dout = os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"drives_{s}.parquet")
        drives.write_parquet(dout)
        extra = ""
        if wk is not None:
            wout = os.path.join(OUTDIR, f"cells_wk_{s}.parquet")
            wk.write_parquet(wout)
            extra = f" + cells_wk_{s}.parquet"
        h = hashlib.sha256(open(__file__, "rb").read()).hexdigest()[:12]
        print(f"wrote {out} + {dout}{extra} (code {h})", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

"""T5 shared utilities: data loading (snapshot-first, nflreadpy fallback),
binning, constants. Seed 3705."""
import os
import polars as pl

SEED = 3705
WORK = os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/gse-discovery/phase6/t5-survival")
SNAP = os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/gse-discovery/data_snapshot_20260913")

SCORE_SET = {"Touchdown", "Field goal"}
DEAD_SET = {"Punt", "Turnover", "Turnover on downs", "Missed field goal",
            "Blocked field goal", "Opp touchdown"}  # Opp touchdown = pick-6 etc:
# drive died scoreless (and defense scored); counts as h_dead event for offense
CENSOR_SET = {"End of half", "End of game", "End of regulation"}
DROP_SET = {"Safety"}  # <0.5% of drives; documented drop per prereg

KEEP_PLAY_TYPES = {"run", "pass", "punt", "field_goal", "qb_kneel", "qb_spike"}

PBP_COLS = ["game_id", "play_id", "drive", "posteam", "defteam", "down",
            "ydstogo", "yardline_100", "score_differential",
            "half_seconds_remaining", "fixed_drive_result", "play_type",
            "qb_kneel", "qb_spike", "epa", "spread_line", "total_line",
            "season", "week", "home_team", "away_team", "game_date"]


def snapshot_pbp_dir():
    d = os.path.join(SNAP, "pbp")
    return d if os.path.isdir(d) else None


def load_pbp_seasons(seasons):
    """Return polars DataFrame with PBP_COLS for given seasons."""
    d = snapshot_pbp_dir()
    if d is not None:
        files = [os.path.join(d, f) for f in sorted(os.listdir(d))
                 if f.endswith(".parquet") and any(str(s) in f for s in seasons)]
        if files:
            df = pl.concat([pl.read_parquet(f, columns=PBP_COLS) for f in files])
            df = df.with_columns(pl.col("season").cast(pl.Int32))
            return df
    import nflreadpy as nfl
    df = nfl.load_pbp(list(seasons))
    keep = [c for c in PBP_COLS if c in df.columns]
    return df.select(keep)


def load_schedules(seasons):
    d = os.path.join(SNAP, "schedules")
    if d and os.path.isdir(d):
        files = [os.path.join(d, f) for f in sorted(os.listdir(d))
                 if f.endswith(".parquet")]
        if files:
            return pl.concat([pl.read_parquet(f) for f in files])
    import nflreadpy as nfl
    return nfl.load_schedules(list(seasons))


def bin_ydstogo(y):
    return pl.when(y <= 1).then(0).when(y == 2).then(1).when(y <= 5).then(2) \
        .when(y <= 9).then(3).when(y == 10).then(4).when(y <= 15).then(5) \
        .otherwise(6).alias("yds_bin")


def bin_yardline(y):
    return pl.when(y <= 10).then(0).when(y <= 25).then(1).when(y <= 40).then(2) \
        .when(y <= 60).then(3).when(y <= 80).then(4).otherwise(5).alias("yl_bin")


def bin_scorediff(s):
    return pl.when(s <= -17).then(0).when(s <= -9).then(1).when(s <= -4).then(2) \
        .when(s <= -1).then(3).when(s == 0).then(4).when(s <= 3).then(5) \
        .when(s <= 8).then(6).when(s <= 16).then(7).otherwise(8).alias("sd_bin")


def bin_clock(c):
    return pl.when(c > 900).then(0).when(c > 300).then(1).when(c > 120).then(2) \
        .otherwise(3).alias("clk_bin")


CELL_KEYS = ["t_bin", "down", "yds_bin", "yl_bin", "sd_bin", "clk_bin",
             "posteam", "defteam"]

title: duel.py
body:
"""T5 duel.py: next-week prediction duel — hazard ratings vs EPA/drive vs Elo.

Pipeline stages (run via CLI flags so each stage can be backgrounded):
  games      build games.parquet (schedules, REG only, normalized line)
  era        static era fits: <=2010, 2011-2017 (+K4 stability, era FE json)
  trainfeat  per-season expanding ratings for train seasons (duel-weight fit)
  weekly     weekly test-era ratings 2018-2025 (the expensive stage)
  eval       duel evaluation: logloss/acc, disagreement, market, permutations
  placebo    P2 synthetic-null + P3 target-shuffle pipeline checks

All stochastic steps use SEED=3705.
"""
import argparse, json, os, sys
import numpy as np
import polars as pl
from common import WORK, SEED, load_schedules

CELLS = os.path.join(WORK, "cells")
OUT = os.path.join(WORK, "duel_out")
TRAIN_END = 2010
VAL = (2011, 2017)
TEST = (2018, 2025)


def logloss(y, p):
    p = np.clip(p, 1e-9, 1 - 1e-9)
    return float(-np.mean(y * np.log(p) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - p)))


def fit_logistic_1d(x, y, max_iter=50):
    """P(y=1)=sigmoid(a+b*x); Newton. Returns (a,b)."""
    X = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(x), x])
    beta = np.zeros(2)
    for _ in range(max_iter):
        eta = X @ beta
        mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(eta, -30, 30)))
        mu = np.clip(mu, 1e-9, 1 - 1e-9)
        W = mu * (1 - mu)
        g = X.T @ (y - mu)
        H = (X * W[:, None]).T @ X + 1e-9 * np.eye(2)
        step = np.linalg.solve(H, g)
        beta += step
        if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-10:
            break
    return float(beta[0]), float(beta[1])


def fit_logistic_nd(X, y, max_iter=50):
    X1 = np.column_stack([np.ones(X.shape[0]), X])
    beta = np.zeros(X1.shape[1])
    for _ in range(max_iter):
        eta = X1 @ beta
        mu = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(eta, -30, 30)))
        mu = np.clip(mu, 1e-9, 1 - 1e-9)
        W = mu * (1 - mu)
        g = X1.T @ (y - mu)
        H = (X1 * W[:, None]).T @ X1 + 1e-9 * np.eye(X1.shape[1])
        step = np.linalg.solve(H, g)
        beta += step
        if np.max(np.abs(step)) < 1e-10:
            break
    return beta


def sigmoid(z):
    return 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(z, -30, 30)))


# ---------------- games ----------------
def stage_games():
    os.makedirs(OUT, exist_ok=True)
    sched = load_schedules(list(range(1999, 2026)))
    cols = sched.columns
    print("schedule cols:", [c for c in
          ["game_id", "season", "week", "game_type", "home_team", "away_team",
           "home_score", "away_score", "spread_line", "total_line"] if c in cols],
          flush=True)
    g = sched.filter(pl.col("game_type") == "REG").select([
        "game_id", "season", "week", "home_team", "away_team",
        "home_score", "away_score", "spread_line"]).drop_nulls(
        ["home_score", "away_score"])
    g = g.with_columns([
        (pl.col("home_score") - pl.col("away_score")).alias("home_margin"),
        (pl.col("home_score") > pl.col("away_score")).cast(pl.Int8).alias("home_win"),
    ])
    # normalize spread_line to home perspective using train-era correlation
    tr = g.filter(pl.col("season") <= TRAIN_END).drop_nulls(["spread_line"])
    c = tr.select(pl.corr("spread_line", "home_margin")).item()
    sign = 1.0 if c > 0 else -1.0
    print(f"corr(spread_line, home_margin) train = {c:.3f} -> sign {sign}", flush=True)
    g = g.with_columns((pl.col("spread_line") * sign).alias("line_home"))
    g.write_parquet(os.path.join(OUT, "games.parquet"))
    meta = {"spread_sign_corr": c, "spread_sign": sign, "n_games": g.shape[0]}
    json.dump(meta, open(os.path.join(OUT, "games_meta.json"), "w"), indent=1)
    print(f"games: {g.shape[0]}", flush=True)


def load_games():
    return pl.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT, "games.parquet"))


# ---------------- cells ----------------
def load_cells(seasons, weekly=False):
    """weekly=True loads cells_wk_{s} (has week col); else cells_{s}."""
    pats = []
    for s in seasons:
        p = os.path.join(CELLS, f"cells_wk_{s}.parquet" if weekly else f"cells_{s}.parquet")
        if os.path.exists(p):
            pats.append(pl.read_parquet(p))
    if not pats:
        return None
    return pl.concat(pats, how="diagonal")


# ---------------- hazard ratings ----------------
def fit_window(cells, beta_init=None):
    from fit_hazard import fit_cells, ratings_from_fits
    fs = fit_cells(cells, "e_score")
    fd = fit_cells(cells, "e_dead")
    S = ratings_from_fits(fs, fd)
    return S, fs, fd


def static_ratings(seasons):
    cells = load_cells(seasons)
    assert cells is not None and cells.shape[0] > 0, f"no cells for {seasons}"
    S, fs, fd = fit_window(cells)
    info = {"converged": bool(fs["converged"] and fd["converged"]),
            "n_cells": cells.shape[0], "n_plays": cells["n"].sum()}
    return S, info


def save_S(S, path):
    json.dump({k: float(v) for k, v in S.items()},
              open(path, "w"), indent=1)


def load_S(path):
    return json.load(open(path))


# ---------------- EPA/drive ratings ----------------
def load_drives(seasons):
    pats = []
    for s in seasons:
        p = os.path.join(CELLS, f"drives_{s}.parquet")
        if os.path.exists(p):
            pats.append(pl.read_parquet(p))
    return pl.concat(pats) if pats else None


def epa_ratings_window(drives, season, week, prior_k=60):
    """drives: full drives df. Window: S-2,S-1 full + S weeks<week (if week>4)."""
    S = season
    w = drives.filter(
        ((pl.col("season") == S - 1) | (pl.col("season") == S - 2))
        | ((pl.col("season") == S) & (pl.col("week") < week) & (week > 4))
    )
    lg = w["epa_sum"].mean()
    off = w.group_by("posteam").agg(
        (pl.col("epa_sum").sum() + prior_k * lg).alias("num"),
        (pl.len() + prior_k).alias("den"))
    off = {r["posteam"]: r["num"] / r["den"] for r in off.to_dicts()}
    dff = w.group_by("defteam").agg(
        (pl.col("epa_sum").sum() + prior_k * lg).alias("num"),
        (pl.len() + prior_k).alias("den"))
    dff = {r["defteam"]: r["num"] / r["den"] for r in dff.to_dicts()}
    return off, dff, float(lg)


class EpaLookup:
    """Precomputed cumulative drive-EPA for fast window queries.

    Window for game (S, W): seasons S-2, S-1 full + season S weeks<W (W>4).
    Matches epa_ratings_window exactly (same prior_k shrinkage, same league
    mean over the window); O(1) per query after one precompute pass.
    """

    def __init__(self, drives, prior_k=60.0):
        self.prior_k = prior_k
        self.season_tot = {}   # S -> (epa_sum, n)
        self.season_wk = {}    # S -> (weeks asc, cum_epa, cum_n)
        self.cum = {}          # (S, side, team) -> (weeks asc, cum_epa, cum_n)
        for S in sorted(drives["season"].unique().to_list()):
            d = drives.filter(pl.col("season") == S)
            e = d["epa_sum"].to_numpy().astype(float)
            n = len(d)
            self.season_tot[S] = (float(e.sum()), n)
            g = (d.group_by("week").agg(pl.col("epa_sum").sum().alias("e"),
                                        pl.len().alias("n")).sort("week"))
            wk = g["week"].to_numpy()
            self.season_wk[S] = (wk, np.cumsum(g["e"].to_numpy().astype(float)),
                                 np.cumsum(g["n"].to_numpy().astype(float)))
            for side, col in (("off", "posteam"), ("def", "defteam")):
                gg = (d.group_by([col, "week"]).agg(
                    pl.col("epa_sum").sum().alias("e"),
                    pl.len().alias("n")).sort([col, "week"]))
                for team in gg[col].unique().to_list():
                    sub = gg.filter(pl.col(col) == team)
                    wkt = sub["week"].to_numpy()
                    self.cum[(S, side, team)] = (
                        wkt, np.cumsum(sub["e"].to_numpy().astype(float)),
                        np.cumsum(sub["n"].to_numpy().astype(float)))

    def _winsum(self, S, side, team, cur_S, cur_W):
        key = (S, side, team)
        if key not in self.cum:
            return 0.0, 0
        wk, ce, cn = self.cum[key]
        if S < cur_S:
            return float(ce[-1]), int(cn[-1])
        if cur_W <= 4:
            return 0.0, 0
        j = int(np.searchsorted(wk, cur_W))  # weeks < cur_W
        if j == 0:
            return 0.0, 0
        return float(ce[j - 1]), int(cn[j - 1])

    def query(self, S, W, team):
        """(off_epa/drive, def_epa/drive) for team before week W of season S."""
        pk = self.prior_k
        tsum, tn = 0.0, 0
        for s in (S - 2, S - 1):
            if s in self.season_tot:
                e, n = self.season_tot[s]
                tsum += e
                tn += n
        if W > 4 and S in self.season_wk:
            wk, ce, cn = self.season_wk[S]
            j = int(np.searchsorted(wk, W))
            if j:
                tsum += float(ce[j - 1])
                tn += int(cn[j - 1])
        lg = tsum / tn if tn else 0.0
        out = []
        for side in ("off", "def"):
            num = den = 0.0
            for s in (S - 2, S - 1, S):
                e, n = self._winsum(s, side, team, S, W)
                num += e
                den += n
            out.append((num + pk * lg) / (den + pk) if (den + pk) else 0.0)
        return out[0], out[1]


# ---------------- Elo ----------------
def elo_walk(games_df, K=24.0, hfa=55.0, snapshot_weeks=None):
    """Walk chronological games; return dict game_id -> (elo_h, elo_a) pre-game.
    snapshot_weeks: set of (season, week) to also dump full rating tables."""
    elo = {}
    pre = {}
    snaps = {}
    g = games_df.sort(["season", "week"])
    for r in g.to_dicts():
        h, a = r["home_team"], r["away_team"]
        eh, ea = elo.get(h, 1500.0), elo.get(a, 1500.0)
        pre[r["game_id"]] = (eh, ea)
        E = 1 / (1 + 10 ** (-((eh - ea) + hfa) / 400))
        y = r["home_win"]
        elo[h] = eh + K * (y - E)
        elo[a] = ea - K * (y - E)
        if snapshot_weeks and (r["season"], r["week"]) in snapshot_weeks:
            snaps[f"{r['season']}_{r['week']}"] = dict(elo)
    return pre, snaps


def fit_elo_params(games_train):
    best = None
    for K in [8, 16, 24, 32, 48]:
        for hfa in [0, 25, 50, 75, 100]:
            pre, _ = elo_walk(games_train, K=K, hfa=hfa)
            xs, ys = [], []
            for r in games_train.to_dicts():
                eh, ea = pre[r["game_id"]]
                E = 1 / (1 + 10 ** (-((eh - ea) + hfa) / 400))
                xs.append(E)
                ys.append(r["home_win"])
            ll = logloss(np.array(ys), np.array(xs))
            if best is None or ll < best[0]:
                best = (ll, K, hfa)
    return best  # (ll, K, hfa)


# ---------------- evaluation helpers ----------------
def paired_perm_pvalue(d, n_perm=10000, seed=SEED):
    """d = per-game loss differences (model - baseline); negative = model better.
    One-sided p: P(perm mean <= observed mean)."""
    rng = np.random.default_rng(seed)
    obs = float(np.mean(d))
    cnt = 0
    for _ in range(n_perm):
        s = rng.choice([-1.0, 1.0], size=d.shape[0])
        if float(np.mean(d * s)) <= obs:
            cnt += 1
    return (cnt + 1) / (n_perm + 1), obs


def bh(pvals):
    """Benjamini-Hochberg; returns adjusted p-values in input order."""
    p = np.array(pvals)
    m = len(p)
    order = np.argsort(p)
    adj = np.empty(m)
    prev = 1.0
    for i in range(m - 1, -1, -1):
        prev = min(prev, p[order[i]] * m / (i + 1))
        adj[order[i]] = prev
    return adj.tolist()


if __name__ == "__main__":
    import stages
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("stage", choices=["games", "era", "trainfeat", "weekly",
                                      "eval", "placebo"])
    a = ap.parse_args()
    {"games": stage_games, "era": stages.stage_era,
     "trainfeat": stages.stage_trainfeat, "weekly": stages.weekly_ratings,
     "eval": stages.stage_eval,
     "placebo": stages.stage_placebo}[a.stage]()

title: fit_hazard.py
body:
"""T5 fit_hazard.py: discrete-time cause-specific hazard via Newton-IRLS.

Weighted logistic regression on aggregated cells:
  logit h_c = intercept + t dummies + down + yds_bin + yl_bin + sd_bin
              + clk_bin + off_c[posteam] + def_c[defteam]
Full-rank parameterization: intercept + drop-first dummies per covariate
(all binned covariates are 0-based in the panel: t_bin 0..14, down 0..3,
*_bin 0..k-1; value 0 is the reference level). Team FE: drop-last team
(reference 0), recentered to exact sum-to-zero => log hazard ratios vs
league-average team. IRLS with backtracking line search (monotone LL),
ridge 1e-6.

API:
  fit_cells(cells_df, event_col) -> dict with coefs, FE, converged, nll, ...
  ratings_from_fits(fit_score, fit_dead) -> {team: S}
CLI: python fit_hazard.py cells_2024.parquet --event e_score --out fit.json
"""
import sys
import numpy as np
import polars as pl

CATS = {
    "t_bin": 15, "down": 4, "yds_bin": 7, "yl_bin": 6, "sd_bin": 9, "clk_bin": 4,
}


def design(cells: pl.DataFrame):
    """Full-rank design matrix. Returns X, col_names, posteam levels,
    defteam levels."""
    n = cells.shape[0]
    cols = [np.ones((n, 1))]
    names = ["intercept"]
    for key, k in CATS.items():
        v = cells[key].to_numpy().astype(int)
        v = np.clip(v, 0, k - 1)
        D = np.zeros((n, k - 1))
        for j in range(1, k):
            D[:, j - 1] = (v == j)
        cols.append(D)
        names += [f"{key}={j}" for j in range(1, k)]
    teams_o = sorted(cells["posteam"].unique().to_list())
    teams_d = sorted(cells["defteam"].unique().to_list())
    for tcol, teams in (("posteam", teams_o), ("defteam", teams_d)):
        v = cells[tcol].to_numpy()
        idx = {t: i for i, t in enumerate(teams)}
        j = np.array([idx[tv] for tv in v])
        keep = j < len(teams) - 1
        D = np.zeros((n, len(teams) - 1))
        D[np.arange(n)[keep], j[keep]] = 1.0
        cols.append(D)
        names += [f"{tcol}={t}" for t in teams[:-1]]
    X = np.hstack(cols)
    assert X.shape[1] == len(names)
    return X, names, teams_o, teams_d


def irls(X, w, y, max_iter=100, tol=1e-8, ridge=1e-6):
    """Newton-IRLS with the CORRECT full update.

    NOTE (2026-09-14 fix): the previous revision used an incremental step
    `beta + solve(XtWX, XtWz - ridge*beta)`, which is not the Newton step
    (it double-counts beta: at ridge=0 it gives beta + (X'WX)^{-1}X'Wz).
    It crawled to max_iter=100 with conv=False on every fit. The standard
    IRLS full update beta = (X'WX + ridge*I)^{-1} X'Wz is the Newton step
    for the penalized log-likelihood (ridge = numerical stabilizer only);
    convergence is checked on |Δℓ| of the unpenalized ℓ per the prereg.
    This restores the preregistered estimator; it is not rescue tuning.
    """
    n, p = X.shape
    beta = np.zeros(p)
    ll_old = -np.inf
    for it in range(max_iter):
        eta = X @ beta
        mu = np.clip(1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(eta, -30, 30))),
                     1e-10, 1 - 1e-10)
        W = w * mu * (1 - mu)
        z = eta + (y - mu) / (mu * (1 - mu))
        XtWX = (X * W[:, None]).T @ X + ridge * np.eye(p)
        XtWz = X.T @ (W * z)
        try:
            beta = np.linalg.solve(XtWX, XtWz)
        except np.linalg.LinAlgError:
            return beta, False, it, ll_old
        eta = X @ beta
        mu = np.clip(1.0 / (1.0 + np.exp(-np.clip(eta, -30, 30))),
                     1e-10, 1 - 1e-10)
        ll = float(np.sum(w * (y * np.log(mu) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - mu))))
        if abs(ll - ll_old) < tol:
            return beta, True, it + 1, ll
        ll_old = ll
    return beta, False, max_iter, ll_old


def recover_fe(beta_names, teams_o, teams_d):
    """Sum-to-zero team FE: dropped (last) team is reference 0; recenter all
    levels to exact zero mean. Log hazard ratios vs league average."""
    off, dff = {}, {}
    for tcol, teams, store in (("posteam", teams_o, off), ("defteam", teams_d, dff)):
        vals = [beta_names[f"{tcol}={t}"] for t in teams[:-1]] + [0.0]
        m = sum(vals) / len(vals)
        for t, v in zip(teams, vals):
            store[t] = v - m
    return off, dff


def fit_cells(cells: pl.DataFrame, event_col: str):
    X, names, teams_o, teams_d = design(cells)
    w = cells["n"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    e = cells[event_col].to_numpy().astype(float)
    y = e / w
    beta, converged, iters, ll = irls(X, w, y)
    bn = dict(zip(names, beta))
    off, dff = recover_fe(bn, teams_o, teams_d)
    icept = bn["intercept"]
    # t_bin 0-based: 0 = first play (reference), 14 = 15th play and beyond
    base = {0: icept}
    base.update({j: icept + bn[f"t_bin={j}"] for j in range(1, 15)})
    cov = {nm: v for nm, v in bn.items()
           if not nm.startswith("posteam=") and not nm.startswith("defteam=")
           and not nm.startswith("t_bin=") and nm != "intercept"}
    return {"beta": bn, "off": off, "def": dff, "baseline": base,
            "cov": cov, "converged": converged, "iters": iters, "nll": -ll,
            "n_cells": X.shape[0], "n_plays": float(w.sum()),
            "n_events": float(e.sum()),
            "teams_o": teams_o, "teams_d": teams_d}


def ratings_from_fits(fit_score, fit_dead):
    """S_i = (off_score - off_dead) - (def_score - def_dead)."""
    teams = sorted(set(fit_score["off"]) & set(fit_dead["off"]))
    return {t: (fit_score["off"][t] - fit_dead["off"][t])
            - (fit_score["def"][t] - fit_dead["def"][t]) for t in teams}


def main():
    import json
    cells_path, event, out = sys.argv[1], sys.argv[3], sys.argv[5]
    cells = pl.read_parquet(cells_path)
    fit = fit_cells(cells, event)
    slim = {k: v for k, v in fit.items() if k not in ("beta", "cov")}
    slim["cov_n"] = len(fit["cov"])
    with open(out, "w") as f:
        json.dump(slim, f, indent=1, default=float)
    print(f"converged={fit['converged']} iters={fit['iters']} "
          f"nll={fit['nll']:.1f} events={fit['n_events']:.0f}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

title: harness_duel.py
body:
"""T5 harness duel report (runs AFTER duel.py eval).

Calls harness.duel_report on test-era per-game log-losses:
hazard ratings vs the better of (EPA/drive, Elo). Seed 3705.
Market comparison is the separate prereg regression (eval.json market);
not forced into duel_report's prob-score interface.
"""
import json
import os
import sys

import numpy as np
import polars as pl

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.expanduser("~/workspace/gse-discovery/phase6"))
from harness import duel_report  # noqa: E402

from common import SEED, WORK  # noqa: E402

OUT = os.path.join(WORK, "duel_out")
TEST = (2018, 2025)


def sigmoid(z):
    return 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(z, -30, 30)))


def main():
    ev = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT, "eval.json")))
    F = pl.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT, "features.parquet"))
    Fte = F.filter((pl.col("season") >= TEST[0]) & (pl.col("season") <= TEST[1]))
    y = Fte["home_win"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    w = ev["duel_weights"]
    ph = sigmoid(w["haz"][0] + w["haz"][1] * Fte["x_haz"].to_numpy())
    be = np.array(w["epa"])
    pe = sigmoid(be[0] + be[1] * Fte["x_epa_off"].to_numpy()
                 + be[2] * Fte["x_epa_def"].to_numpy())
    pl_ = sigmoid(w["elo"][0] + w["elo"][1] * Fte["x_elo"].to_numpy())

    def ll(p):
        p = np.clip(p, 1e-9, 1 - 1e-9)
        return -(y * np.log(p) + (1 - y) * np.log(1 - p))

    lh, le, ll_ = ll(ph), ll(pe), ll(pl_)
    if float(np.mean(le)) < float(np.mean(ll_)):
        base, bname = le, "epa_per_drive"
    else:
        base, bname = ll_, "elo"
    path = duel_report(
        "t5_survival_hazard", "logloss",
        family_scores=lh, baseline_scores=base,
        baseline_name=bname, higher_is_better=False,
        test_set_desc=("NFL regular seasons 2018-2025; all ratings use only "
                       "data available before each week's games"),
        seed=SEED, out_dir=OUT)
    print("wrote", path, flush=True)
    print(f"mean logloss: haz={np.mean(lh):.4f} {bname}={np.mean(base):.4f} "
          f"n={len(y)}", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import sys, time
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
import polars as pl
from fit_hazard import fit_cells, ratings_from_fits
t0=time.time()
cells = pl.read_parquet("cells/cells_2024.parquet")
print(f"[{time.time()-t0:.0f}s] cells {cells.shape}", flush=True)
fs = fit_cells(cells, "e_score")
print(f"[{time.time()-t0:.0f}s] score fit: iters={fs['iters']} NLL={fs['nll']:.1f}", flush=True)
fd = fit_cells(cells, "e_dead")
print(f"[{time.time()-t0:.0f}s] dead fit: iters={fd['iters']} NLL={fd['nll']:.1f}", flush=True)
S = ratings_from_fits(fs, fd)
top = sorted(S.items(), key=lambda kv: -kv[1])[:5]
bot = sorted(S.items(), key=lambda kv: kv[1])[:5]
print("top5:", [(t, round(v,3)) for t,v in top], flush=True)

body:
"""Run P3 placebo only (target shuffle, 2 fits)."""
import json
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import numpy as np
import polars as pl

from duel import OUT, load_cells
from fit_hazard import fit_cells
from common import SEED


def main():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    cells = load_cells(list(range(1999, 2011)))
    n = cells["n"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    # P3: target shuffle within (t_bin, down, yl_bin) strata
    e_s = cells["e_score"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    e_d = cells["e_dead"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    e_s_new = np.zeros_like(e_s)
    e_d_new = np.zeros_like(e_d)
    key = (
        cells["t_bin"].to_numpy().astype(int) * 100
        + cells["down"].to_numpy().astype(int) * 10
        + cells["yl_bin"].to_numpy().astype(int)
    )
    for k in np.unique(key):
        m = key == k
        for e, enew in ((e_s, e_s_new), (e_d, e_d_new)):
            rate = e[m].sum() / n[m].sum()
            enew[m] = rng.binomial(n[m].astype(int), np.clip(rate, 1e-9, 1 - 1e-9))
    shuf = cells.with_columns(
        [
            pl.Series("e_score", e_s_new).alias("e_score"),
            pl.Series("e_dead", e_d_new).alias("e_dead"),
        ]
    )
    print("fitting P3 null...", flush=True)
    fs1 = fit_cells(shuf, "e_score")
    fd1 = fit_cells(shuf, "e_dead")
    maxfe1 = max(
        max(abs(v) for v in fs1["off"].values()),
        max(abs(v) for v in fs1["def"].values()),
        max(abs(v) for v in fd1["off"].values()),
        max(abs(v) for v in fd1["def"].values()),
    )
    out = {"P3": {"max_abs_FE": float(maxfe1), "pass": bool(maxfe1 < 0.05)}}
    print(f"P3: max|FE|={maxfe1:.4f} pass={out['P3']['pass']}", flush=True)
    json.dump(out, open(os.path.join(OUT, "placebo_p3.json"), "w"), indent=1)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

title: placebo_stage.py
body:
"""Appended: stage_placebo for stages.py (imported at end of stages)."""
import json
import os

import numpy as np
import polars as pl
from duel import (OUT, load_games, load_cells, fit_logistic_1d, sigmoid,
                  logloss)
from common import SEED
from fit_hazard import fit_cells, ratings_from_fits, design


def _eta_cov(cells, fit):
    """Covariate-only linear predictor per cell (team FE zeroed)."""
    X, names, _, _ = design(cells)
    beta = np.array([fit["beta"][nm] for nm in names])
    team_mask = np.array([nm.startswith("posteam=") or nm.startswith("defteam=")
                          for nm in names])
    beta[team_mask] = 0.0
    return X @ beta


def stage_placebo():
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    cells = load_cells(list(range(1999, 2011)))
    n = cells["n"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    out = {}

    # ---- P2: synthetic null (FE = 0), parametric bootstrap ----
    fs = fit_cells(cells, "e_score")
    fd = fit_cells(cells, "e_dead")
    null = cells.clone()
    for ev, f in (("e_score", fs), ("e_dead", fd)):
        p0 = 1 / (1 + np.exp(-np.clip(_eta_cov(cells, f), -30, 30)))
        null = null.with_columns(
            pl.Series(f"{ev}_null", rng.binomial(n.astype(int),
                                                 np.clip(p0, 1e-6, 1 - 1e-6))).alias(ev))
    # refit on null (rename trick: fit_cells reads event col)
    fs0 = fit_cells(null, "e_score")
    fd0 = fit_cells(null, "e_dead")
    S0 = ratings_from_fits(fs0, fd0)
    maxfe = max(max(abs(v) for v in fs0["off"].values()),
                max(abs(v) for v in fs0["def"].values()),
                max(abs(v) for v in fd0["off"].values()),
                max(abs(v) for v in fd0["def"].values()))
    maxS = max(abs(v) for v in S0.values())
    # duel with null ratings on test era (static null ratings for all test games)
    ev = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT, "eval.json")))
    games = load_games()
    gte = games.filter((pl.col("season") >= 2018) & (pl.col("season") <= 2025))
    a_h, b_h = ev["duel_weights"]["haz"]
    be = np.array(ev["duel_weights"]["epa"])
    a_e, b_e = ev["duel_weights"]["elo"]
    F = pl.read_parquet(os.path.join(OUT, "features.parquet"))
    Fte = F.filter((pl.col("season") >= 2018) & (pl.col("season") <= 2025))
    xh0 = np.array([S0.get(r["home"], 0.0) - S0.get(r["away"], 0.0)
                    for r in Fte.to_dicts()])
    yte = Fte["home_win"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    ph0 = sigmoid(a_h + b_h * xh0)
    xe = np.column_stack([Fte["x_epa_off"].to_numpy(), Fte["x_epa_def"].to_numpy()])
    pe = sigmoid(be[0] + xe @ be[1:])
    pl_ = sigmoid(a_e + b_e * Fte["x_elo"].to_numpy())
    lh0, le, ll_ = (logloss(yte, ph0), logloss(yte, pe), logloss(yte, pl_))
    dnull = lh0 - min(le, ll_)
    out["P2"] = {"max_abs_FE": float(maxfe), "max_abs_S": float(maxS),
                 "null_logloss": lh0, "delta_vs_best_baseline": float(dnull),
                 # A10: one-sided gate — null must not spuriously WIN
                 "pass": bool(maxfe < 0.05 and dnull > -0.002)}
    print(f"P2: max|FE|={maxfe:.4f} max|S|={maxS:.4f} null_ll={lh0:.4f} "
          f"delta={dnull:+.4f} pass={out['P2']['pass']}", flush=True)

    # ---- P3: target shuffle within (t_bin, down, yl_bin) strata ----
    shuf = cells.clone()
    strata = cells.select(["t_bin", "down", "yl_bin"]).unique()
    e_s = cells["e_score"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    e_d = cells["e_dead"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    e_s_new = np.zeros_like(e_s)
    e_d_new = np.zeros_like(e_d)
    key = (cells["t_bin"].to_numpy().astype(int) * 100 +
           cells["down"].to_numpy().astype(int) * 10 +
           cells["yl_bin"].to_numpy().astype(int))
    for k in np.unique(key):
        m = key == k
        for e, enew in ((e_s, e_s_new), (e_d, e_d_new)):
            rate = e[m].sum() / n[m].sum()
            enew[m] = rng.binomial(n[m].astype(int), np.clip(rate, 1e-9, 1 - 1e-9))
    shuf = shuf.with_columns([pl.Series("e_score", e_s_new).alias("e_score"),
                              pl.Series("e_dead", e_d_new).alias("e_dead")])
    fs1 = fit_cells(shuf, "e_score")
    fd1 = fit_cells(shuf, "e_dead")
    maxfe1 = max(max(abs(v) for v in fs1["off"].values()),
                 max(abs(v) for v in fs1["def"].values()),
                 max(abs(v) for v in fd1["off"].values()),
                 max(abs(v) for v in fd1["def"].values()))
    out["P3"] = {"max_abs_FE": float(maxfe1), "pass": bool(maxfe1 < 0.05)}
    print(f"P3: max|FE|={maxfe1:.4f} pass={out['P3']['pass']}", flush=True)
    json.dump(out, open(os.path.join(OUT, "placebo.json"), "w"), indent=1)

import numpy as np
import polars as pl
from duel import (OUT, CELLS, TRAIN_END, VAL, TEST, load_games, load_cells,
                  load_drives, static_ratings, save_S, load_S, epa_ratings_window,
                  EpaLookup,
                  elo_walk, fit_elo_params, fit_logistic_1d, fit_logistic_nd,
                  sigmoid, logloss, paired_perm_pvalue, bh)
from common import SEED
from fit_hazard import fit_cells, ratings_from_fits


def stage_era():
    """Static fits: train <=2010, validation 2011-2017. K4 stability."""
    games = load_games()
    S_tr, info_tr = static_ratings(list(range(1999, TRAIN_END + 1)))
    save_S(S_tr, os.path.join(OUT, "S_train_1999_2010.json"))
    S_va, info_va = static_ratings(list(range(VAL[0], VAL[1] + 1)))
    save_S(S_va, os.path.join(OUT, "S_val_2011_2017.json"))
    teams = sorted(set(S_tr) & set(S_va))
    x = np.array([S_tr[t] for t in teams])
    y = np.array([S_va[t] for t in teams])
    # Spearman
    rx = np.argsort(np.argsort(x)).astype(float)
    ry = np.argsort(np.argsort(y)).astype(float)
    rho = float(np.corrcoef(rx, ry)[0, 1])
    # permutation p for rho>0
    rng = np.random.default_rng(SEED)
    cnt = sum(float(np.corrcoef(rx, rng.permutation(ry))[0, 1]) >= rho
              for _ in range(10000))
    p = (cnt + 1) / 10001
    res = {"rho": rho, "p_perm": p, "n_teams": len(teams),
           "train_info": info_tr, "val_info": info_va}
    json.dump(res, open(os.path.join(OUT, "k4_stability.json"), "w"), indent=1)
    print(f"K4: spearman rho={rho:.3f} p={p:.4f} n={len(teams)}", flush=True)
    print("train converged:", info_tr["converged"], "val converged:",
          info_va["converged"], flush=True)


def per_season_ratings(seasons):
    """Static per-season S (ratings for season S use seasons < S only via caller)."""
    out = {}
    for s in seasons:
        S, info = static_ratings(list(range(1999, s)))
        out[s] = S
        print(f"season {s}: conv={info['converged']} plays={info['n_plays']:.0f}",
              flush=True)
    return out


def stage_trainfeat():
    """Per-season expanding hazard ratings for train seasons 2002..2010.
    Duel weights fit on these games (no lookahead: season S rated from <S)."""
    games = load_games()
    S_by_season = per_season_ratings(list(range(2002, TRAIN_END + 1)))
    for s, S in S_by_season.items():
        save_S(S, os.path.join(OUT, f"S_season_{s}.json"))
    # Elo params on train
    gtr = games.filter(pl.col("season") <= TRAIN_END)
    llk, K, hfa = fit_elo_params(gtr)
    json.dump({"K": K, "hfa": hfa, "train_logloss": llk},
              open(os.path.join(OUT, "elo_params.json"), "w"), indent=1)
    print(f"Elo params: K={K} hfa={hfa} train_ll={llk:.4f}", flush=True)


def _weekly_one(task):
    """Module scope (spawn-safe). task=(S,W). Window: S-2,S-1 full + S weeks<W."""
    from duel import load_cells
    from fit_hazard import fit_cells, ratings_from_fits
    import polars as pl
    S, W = task
    base = load_cells([S - 2, S - 1])
    if W > 4:
        wk = load_cells([S], weekly=True)
        if wk is not None:
            wk = wk.filter(pl.col("week") < W).drop("week")
            if wk.shape[0]:
                base = pl.concat([base, wk], how="diagonal")
    fs = fit_cells(base, "e_score")
    fd = fit_cells(base, "e_dead")
    return (S, W, ratings_from_fits(fs, fd),
            bool(fs["converged"] and fd["converged"]))


def weekly_ratings(seasons=range(2011, 2026)):
    """Rolling weekly hazard S for validation+test eras.

    Identical window for every game: seasons S-2,S-1 full + season S weeks<W
    (weeks<=4 use S-2,S-1 only). Same window definition as EPA/Elo inputs.
    """
    import multiprocessing as mp
    # NOTE (2026-09-14): must use spawn, not fork. The parent has polars'
    # thread pool active; fork inherits its locks broken and the workers
    # deadlock in futex wait (observed). Spawn starts clean children.
    # _weekly_one is module-level (spawn-safe) with local imports.
    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
    games = load_games()
    tw = (games.filter(pl.col("season").is_in(list(seasons)))
          .select(["season", "week"]).unique().sort(["season", "week"]))
    tasks = [(r["season"], r["week"]) for r in tw.to_dicts()]
    os.makedirs(os.path.join(OUT, "weekly"), exist_ok=True)
    # Resume: skip weeks already computed (safe: deterministic given snapshot).
    tasks = [(S, W) for (S, W) in tasks
             if not os.path.exists(os.path.join(OUT, "weekly", f"S_{S}_w{W}.json"))]
    print(f"weekly: {len(tasks)} tasks remaining", flush=True)
    with ctx.Pool(2) as pool:
        for S, W, Sdict, conv in pool.imap_unordered(_weekly_one, tasks):
            save_S(Sdict, os.path.join(OUT, "weekly", f"S_{S}_w{W}.json"))
            print(f"weekly {S} w{W}: conv={conv}", flush=True)


def _features(games, S_of_game, epa_of_game, elo_pre, hfa):
    """Build feature frame. S_of_game: dict game_id->S dict; epa: game_id->(off,dff);
    elo_pre: game_id->(eh,ea)."""
    rows = []
    for r in games.to_dicts():
        gid = r["game_id"]
        h, a = r["home_team"], r["away_team"]
        S = S_of_game[gid]
        sh = S.get(h, 0.0) - S.get(a, 0.0)
        off, dff = epa_of_game[gid]
        epa_h = (off.get(h, 0.0) - off.get(a, 0.0), dff.get(h, 0.0) - dff.get(a, 0.0))
        eh, ea = elo_pre[gid]
        rows.append((gid, r["season"], r["week"], h, a, r["home_win"],
                     r["home_margin"], r["line_home"], sh,
                     epa_h[0], epa_h[1], (eh - ea) + hfa))
    return pl.DataFrame(rows, schema=["game_id", "season", "week", "home", "away",
                                     "home_win", "home_margin", "line_home",
                                     "x_haz", "x_epa_off", "x_epa_def", "x_elo"])


def stage_eval():
    games = load_games()
    # A3: 1999-2001 have no hazard ratings (per-season expanding starts 2002);
    # they are never used (train/val/test all >=2002). Drop to avoid KeyError.
    games = games.filter(pl.col("season") >= 2002)
    meta = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT, "games_meta.json")))
    gtr = games.filter((pl.col("season") >= 2002) & (pl.col("season") <= TRAIN_END))  # A3: duel weights on 2002..2010 only (per-season expanding ratings exist from 2002)
    gva = games.filter((pl.col("season") >= VAL[0]) & (pl.col("season") <= VAL[1]))
    gte = games.filter((pl.col("season") >= TEST[0]) & (pl.col("season") <= TEST[1]))

    # --- hazard features: train (per-season expanding), val/test (weekly) ---
    S_of_game, epa_of_game = {}, {}
    drives_all = load_drives(list(range(1999, 2026)))
    epa_look = EpaLookup(drives_all)
    for r in gtr.to_dicts():
        s = r["season"]
        S_of_game[r["game_id"]] = load_S(os.path.join(OUT, f"S_season_{s}.json"))
    for r in gva.to_dicts():
        p = os.path.join(OUT, "weekly", f"S_{r['season']}_w{r['week']}.json")
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            raise FileNotFoundError(f"missing weekly rating {p}; run 'weekly' stage")
        S_of_game[r["game_id"]] = load_S(p)
    for r in gte.to_dicts():
        S_of_game[r["game_id"]] = load_S(
            os.path.join(OUT, "weekly", f"S_{r['season']}_w{r['week']}.json"))
    for r in games.to_dicts():
        off = {}
        dff = {}
        for t in (r["home_team"], r["away_team"]):
            o, d = epa_look.query(r["season"], r["week"], t)
            off[t], dff[t] = o, d
        epa_of_game[r["game_id"]] = (off, dff)
    elo_params = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT, "elo_params.json")))
    elo_pre, _ = elo_walk(games, K=elo_params["K"], hfa=elo_params["hfa"])

    # A3: features only for 2002+ (S ratings exist from 2002; 1999-2001 are lookahead buffer)
    games_02 = games.filter(pl.col("season") >= 2002)
    F = _features(games_02, S_of_game, epa_of_game, elo_pre, elo_params["hfa"])
    F.write_parquet(os.path.join(OUT, "features.parquet"))

    # labels taken from the same feature frame (guaranteed row alignment)
    Ftr = F.filter((pl.col("season") >= 2002) & (pl.col("season") <= TRAIN_END))  # A3: match gtr (no 1999-2001 lookahead rows)
    Fva = F.filter((pl.col("season") >= VAL[0]) & (pl.col("season") <= VAL[1]))
    Fte = F.filter((pl.col("season") >= TEST[0]) & (pl.col("season") <= TEST[1]))
    ytr = Ftr["home_win"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    yva = Fva["home_win"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    yte = Fte["home_win"].to_numpy().astype(float)

    # duel weights on train
    a_h, b_h = fit_logistic_1d(Ftr["x_haz"].to_numpy(), ytr)
    beta_epa = fit_logistic_nd(
        np.column_stack([Ftr["x_epa_off"].to_numpy(), Ftr["x_epa_def"].to_numpy()]), ytr)
    a_e, b_e = fit_logistic_1d(Ftr["x_elo"].to_numpy(), ytr)

    def preds(Fx):
        xh = Fx["x_haz"].to_numpy()
        xe = np.column_stack([Fx["x_epa_off"].to_numpy(), Fx["x_epa_def"].to_numpy()])
        xl = Fx["x_elo"].to_numpy()
        ph = sigmoid(a_h + b_h * xh)
        pe = sigmoid(beta_epa[0] + xe @ beta_epa[1:])
        pl_ = sigmoid(a_e + b_e * xl)
        return ph, pe, pl_

    out = {"duel_weights": {"haz": [a_h, b_h], "epa": beta_epa.tolist(),
                            "elo": [a_e, b_e]},
           "elo_params": elo_params}
    for name, Fx, y in [("train", Ftr, ytr), ("valid", Fva, yva), ("test", Fte, yte)]:
        ph, pe, pl_ = preds(Fx)
        out[name] = {
            "n": int(len(y)),
            "logloss_haz": logloss(y, ph), "logloss_epa": logloss(y, pe),
            "logloss_elo": logloss(y, pl_),
            "acc_haz": float(np.mean((ph > 0.5) == y)),
            "acc_epa": float(np.mean((pe > 0.5) == y)),
            "acc_elo": float(np.mean((pl_ > 0.5) == y)),
        }
    # implied spreads (OLS margin ~ x on train)
    mtr = Ftr["home_margin"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    def ols(x):
        A = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(x), x])
        coef, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, mtr, rcond=None)
        return coef
    xe_score_tr = (beta_epa[1] * Ftr["x_epa_off"].to_numpy()
                   + beta_epa[2] * Ftr["x_epa_def"].to_numpy())
    c_h = ols(Ftr["x_haz"].to_numpy())
    c_e = ols(xe_score_tr)
    c_l = ols(Ftr["x_elo"].to_numpy())
    mte = Fte["home_margin"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    xh = Fte["x_haz"].to_numpy()
    xe_score = (beta_epa[1] * Fte["x_epa_off"].to_numpy()
                + beta_epa[2] * Fte["x_epa_def"].to_numpy())
    xl = Fte["x_elo"].to_numpy()
    spr_h = c_h[0] + c_h[1] * xh
    spr_e = c_e[0] + c_e[1] * xe_score
    line = Fte["line_home"].to_numpy().astype(float)
    out["test"]["rmse_spread_haz"] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((spr_h - mte) ** 2)))
    out["test"]["rmse_spread_epa"] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((spr_e - mte) ** 2)))
    out["test"]["rmse_line"] = float(np.sqrt(np.mean((line - mte) ** 2)))

    # K1: paired permutation, hazard vs better baseline, test logloss
    ph, pe, pl_ = preds(Fte)
    ll = lambda p: -(yte * np.log(np.clip(p, 1e-9, 1 - 1e-9)) +
                     (1 - yte) * np.log(np.clip(1 - p, 1e-9, 1 - 1e-9)))
    lh, le, ll_ = ll(ph), ll(pe), ll(pl_)
    # K1 prereg: baseline is the GLOBALLY better of EPA/Elo (fixed model),
    # not the per-game oracle. (Fixed 2026-09-14: was np.minimum(le, ll_).)
    base = le if np.mean(le) < np.mean(ll_) else ll_
    p1, obs1 = paired_perm_pvalue(lh - base)
    out["K1"] = {"p_perm": p1, "delta_logloss": obs1, "n": int(len(yte)),
                 "baseline": "epa" if np.mean(le) < np.mean(ll_) else "elo"}

    # K2: disagreement region |spr_h - spr_e| >= 2
    disag = np.abs(spr_h - spr_e) >= 2.0
    out["K2"] = {"n_disagree": int(disag.sum())}
    if disag.sum() >= 150:
        p2, obs2 = paired_perm_pvalue((lh - le)[disag])
        out["K2"].update({"p_perm": p2, "delta_logloss": obs2})

    # Market duel: margin ~ line + edge_haz + edge_epa (test)
    edge_h = spr_h - line
    edge_e = spr_e - line
    A = np.column_stack([np.ones_like(line), line, edge_h, edge_e])
    coef, res, *_ = np.linalg.lstsq(A, mte, rcond=None)
    dof = len(mte) - 4
    s2 = float(res[0] / dof) if len(res) else float(np.mean((mte - A @ coef) ** 2))
    se = np.sqrt(np.diag(s2 * np.linalg.inv(A.T @ A)))
    t_h, t_e = coef[2] / se[2], coef[3] / se[3]
    from scipy.stats import t as tdist
    p_h = 2 * float(tdist.sf(abs(t_h), dof))
    p_e = 2 * float(tdist.sf(abs(t_e), dof))
    out["market"] = {"coef_line": float(coef[1]), "coef_edge_haz": float(coef[2]),
                     "t_haz": float(t_h), "p_haz": p_h,
                     "coef_edge_epa": float(coef[3]), "t_epa": float(t_e),
                     "p_epa": p_e}

    # BH across {K1, K2(if run), market p_haz, K4}
    k4 = json.load(open(os.path.join(OUT, "k4_stability.json")))
    pvals = [out["K1"]["p_perm"]]
    names = ["K1"]
    if "p_perm" in out["K2"]:
        pvals.append(out["K2"]["p_perm"]); names.append("K2")
    pvals.append(out["market"]["p_haz"]); names.append("market_haz")
    pvals.append(k4["p_perm"]); names.append("K4")
    adj = bh(pvals)
    out["BH"] = dict(zip(names, adj))
    out["K4"] = k4
    json.dump(out, open(os.path.join(OUT, "eval.json"), "w"), indent=1,
              default=float)
    print(json.dumps({k: out[k] for k in ["train", "valid", "test", "K1", "K2",
                                          "market", "BH"]}, indent=1, default=float),
          flush=True)

"""Run remaining weekly rating tasks, skipping already-completed files."""
import os
import sys

sys.path.insert(0, os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__)))
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
import multiprocessing as mp

import polars as pl

from stages import _weekly_one, load_games, save_S, OUT


def main():
    games = load_games()
    tw = (
        games.filter(pl.col("season").is_in(list(range(2011, 2026))))
        .select(["season", "week"])
        .unique()
        .sort(["season", "week"])
    )
    tasks = []
    for r in tw.to_dicts():
        S, W = r["season"], r["week"]
        path = os.path.join(OUT, "weekly", f"S_{S}_w{W}.json")
        if os.path.exists(path):
            continue
        # W=2,3,4 use the identical window as W=1 (S-2,S-1 only); the W=1
        # file will be copied to W=2,3,4 after the run. Skip redundant fits.
        if W in (2, 3, 4):
            continue
        tasks.append((S, W))
    print(f"remaining tasks: {len(tasks)}", flush=True)
    ctx = mp.get_context("spawn")
    with ctx.Pool(2) as pool:
        for S, W, Sdict, conv in pool.imap_unordered(_weekly_one, tasks):
            save_S(Sdict, os.path.join(OUT, "weekly", f"S_{S}_w{W}.json"))
            print(f"weekly {S} w{W}: conv={conv}", flush=True)
    print("weekly remainder done", flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

title: PREREG.md
body:
# T6 — Bayesian Hierarchical Partial Pooling — PREREGISTRATION
MOVE-37 Phase 6 | Family T6 | Worker: Motif | 2026-09-13
Status: PREREGISTERED — no estimation run on data yet.

## 1. Estimand
For each team-season (t, s): latent offensive strength O[t,s] and defensive
strength D[t,s], defined as expected EPA/play on offense (resp. allowed on
defense, sign-flipped) relative to that era's league mean. Estimand used for
game prediction: predicted score margin in game g between home A and away B:

  margin_hat = (O[A] - D[B]) - (O[B] - D[A]) + HFA

where ratings are fitted on games already played *in the same season before
game g* (weeks 1..w-1 predicting week w), and HFA is a scalar estimated on
the training era.

## 2. Pooling structure (the discovery claim)
Public models shrink early-season ratings ad hoc (e.g., "blend with prior
season" or fixed shrinkage constants). T6 replaces that with principled
partial pooling: team-game EPA/play observations y[i] (team t, game i, n[i]
plays) are modeled as

  y[i] | theta[t] ~ Normal(theta[t], sigma2 / n[i])
  theta[t] ~ Normal(mu_era, tau2)

Hyperparameters (mu_era, sigma2, tau2_offense, tau2_defense) estimated by
marginal maximum likelihood (empirical Bayes) on the TRAIN era; mu_era is
the era league mean (fixed at 0 after centering). Posterior-mean team
ratings are analytic James-Stein-style shrinkage:

  theta_hat[t] = lambda[t] * ybar[t] + (1 - lambda[t]) * mu_era,
  lambda[t] = tau2 / (tau2 + sigma2 / n[t])

The discovery question: does *properly estimated* shrinkage (tau2 from the
data, observation noise scaled by actual play counts) beat (a) no shrinkage
and (b) the ad-hoc shrinkage baked into Elo, on small-sample early-season
game prediction? The duel ground is weeks 1-6, where n[t] is small and
lambda[t] << 1 for most teams.

## 3. Priors and identification (stated explicitly)
- No subjective priors anywhere. Prior mean = era league mean (0 after
  centering); prior variance tau2 = ML estimate from the train era marginal
  likelihood. This is empirical Bayes, not fully Bayesian: priors are
  estimated, not chosen.
- Identification: tau2 is identified from between-team variance in
  game-level EPA/play *after* subtracting within-team sampling variance
  sigma2/n. If between-team variance is fully explained by sampling noise
  (tau2_hat ~ 0), the model reduces to "all teams are average" and the duel
  result will show it. Flat-surface diagnostic (Phase-6 §4 rule 2): report
  the maximized marginal log-likelihood at tau2_hat vs at tau2 = 0 and vs
  tau2 = +inf (no-pooling limit); if the profile is flat (difference <
  ~2 log-points per degree of freedom), tau2 is unidentified and T6 is
  killed regardless of duel outcomes.
- HFA: estimated once on train era as mean(home margin - predicted margin
  at zero ratings); frozen for validate/test.
- Era-split: TRAIN <= 2010 (hyperparameters: tau2, sigma2, HFA), VALIDATE
  2011-2017 (tune: which plays included — see §5; prediction horizon choice),
  TEST 2018-2025 (final duel, run once).

## 4. Computation choice (documented, per task)
This box has no PyMC/Stan and ~2 CPUs / ~3GB free RAM. Full MCMC is not
runnable, and pretending otherwise would be dishonest. The implementation
is empirical Bayes with analytic posterior means (numpy/scipy only):
marginal likelihood maximized with scipy.optimize on the train era,
shrinkage applied in closed form. For this estimand (Normal-Normal
conjugate), analytic empirical Bayes IS the correct posterior-mean
solution — MCMC would add nothing but Monte Carlo error. Stated limitation:
no full posterior credible intervals; uncertainty in tau2 is propagated
by re-fitting on the validate era and checking stability of duel outcomes.

## 5. Duel spec (mandatory, per §4 rule 6)
All three contestants predict the same test games, trained only on the
same season's earlier weeks:
- HIER (T6): empirical-Bayes hierarchical EPA/play ratings, per §1-2.
- RAW: raw team-mean EPA/play from prior weeks, no shrinkage, no prior
  (the naive estimator the pooling is supposed to improve on).
- ELO: standard Elo on game W/L, K-factor tuned on VALIDATE era only,
  prior rating 1500, home-field parameter fit on TRAIN.
Prediction metrics per game: log-loss of predicted win probability and
binary accuracy. Win probability from margin_hat via probit link
(p = Phi(margin_hat / s)), with s fit on VALIDATE; same s applied to all
three contestants (ELO uses its own expected-score formula, kept as-is
since that is the public baseline people actually use).

Two duels:
- PRIMARY (kill gate): weeks 1-6 games, TEST 2018-2025. The theory says
  pooling dominates in the small-sample regime; if it doesn't win HERE,
  the family has nothing.
- SECONDARY (completeness): full-season (weeks 1-18) games, TEST 2018-2025.
  Reported, not a kill gate: by late season lambda[t] -> 1 and all
  contestants converge, so a tie here is expected, not a failure.

Design decisions (tunable ONLY on VALIDATE, frozen before TEST):
- Play inclusion: regular-season plays only; EPA/play per team-game.
  Include/exclude garbage-time (WP>0.95 or <0.05): decided on VALIDATE.
- Offense and defense pooled separately (two tau2 values).
- Neutral-site games: HFA=0.

## 6. Permutation / placebo (mandatory, per §4 rule 4)
- Permutation: shuffle team labels on team-game observations within each
  TEST season (destroying true team structure), re-run HIER vs RAW vs ELO.
  Expectation under a working pipeline: all three tie (~0.5 accuracy, equal
  log-loss); specifically HIER must NOT beat baselines on permuted data
  beyond chance. If HIER "wins" under permutation, the pipeline leaks and
  everything is void.
- Placebo: synthetic null dataset, same size as TEST, team effects drawn
  ~ N(0, 1e-6), outcomes from a probit with HFA only. HIER vs RAW vs ELO
  must tie. If any contestant shows an edge, the evaluation code is biased.

## 7. Quantitative kill criteria (pre-registered, no HARKing)
On TEST 2018-2025 weeks 1-6 games, per-game paired differences:
  d1 = logloss(RAW) - logloss(HIER), d2 = logloss(ELO) - logloss(HIER)
- KILL if one-sided paired t-test fails to reject d1 <= 0 at alpha=0.05.
- KILL if one-sided paired t-test fails to reject d2 <= 0 at alpha=0.05.
- Both p-values Holm-corrected within T6 (2 comparisons). A "win" needs
  both corrected p < 0.05 AND mean(d) > 0.
- KILL if tau2_hat is unidentified (profile flatness, §3).
- KILL if HIER wins TEST but fails the same two tests on VALIDATE
  (pre-TEST sanity: if it doesn't work on 2011-2017, it doesn't touch 2018-2025).
- KILL if HIER's wins come only from the HFA term (ablation: HIER with
  HFA=0 vs RAW; if the pooling itself adds nothing, the discovery is
  "home field advantage," which is not a discovery).
Secondary expectations (not kill gates): full-season TEST should show no
significant differences (convergence); permuted/placebo must show none.

If any KILL fires: one-line obituary in REPORT.md, code kept, no further
runs on this family.

## 8. Discovery bar (§7) — honest pre-assessment
- (a) Duel: HIER vs RAW/ELO is the dumb-baseline duel. Market duel (§4
  rule 7): ALSO tested vs closing spread_line probit; T6 claims a
  *method* for ratings, not a market edge. Report HIER vs spread: if HIER
  beats RAW/ELO but not the market, verdict is "interesting, not an edge."
- (b) Era-split: built in (§3).
- (c) Permutation/placebo + Holm correction: built in (§6-7).
- (d) One-paragraph statement: "Early-season team ratings should be
  shrunk toward the league mean by a factor estimated from how much true
  team-to-team variation exists relative to game-to-game noise; the data
  say the factor is <factor>, which beats raw averages and Elo by
  <margin> log-loss points on weeks 1-6, 2018-2025."
Pre-assessment of risk: this is a method improvement, not a new
structure. Most likely outcome is a small but real win in weeks 1-6. A
NULL is publishable ("proper pooling adds nothing beyond Elo's ad-hoc
shrinkage") and honest.

## 9. Reproducibility
- Fixed seeds: RNG_SEED = 20260913 (all stochastic steps: permutation,
  placebo draws, any resampling).
- Data: frozen snapshot ~/workspace/gse-discovery/data_snapshot_20260913/
  ONLY. No full runs on unversioned pulls. Small-sample code tests on
  nflreadpy direct pulls are for smoke-testing code paths, not results.
- Every run logs: git/code hash, snapshot MANIFEST hash, full stdout to
  RUNLOG.md. Results reproducible from snapshot by a third party.

## 10. File manifest (work dir ~/workspace/gse-discovery/phase6/t6-hierarchical/)
- PREREG.md (this file)
- t6_duel.py — full pipeline: hyperparameter fit, ratings, Elo, duels,
  permutation, placebo, Holm tests
- RUNLOG.md — dated run log
- REPORT.md — verdict + numbers or obituary
